# netbox_vlan (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/vlans/#vlans):

> A VLAN represents an isolated layer two domain, identified by a name and a numeric ID (1-4094) as defined in IEEE 802.1Q. VLANs are arranged into VLAN groups to define scope and to enforce uniqueness.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_vlan" "example1" {
  name = "VLAN 1"
  vid  = 1777
  tags = []
}

# Assume netbox_tenant, netbox_site, and netbox_tag resources exist
resource "netbox_vlan" "example2" {
  name        = "VLAN 2"
  vid         = 1778
  status      = "reserved"
  description = "Reserved example VLAN"
  tenant_id   = netbox_tenant.ex.id
  site_id     = netbox_site.ex.id
  group_id    = netbox_vlan_group.ex.id
  tags        = [netbox_tag.ex.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the vlan.
- `vid` (Number) The VLAN ID (1-4094).

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the vlan.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the vlan. Defaults to `""`.
- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group associated with the vlan.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the vlan. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `qinq_role` (String) One of [svlan, cvlan].
- `qinq_svlan` (Number) The qinq svlan of the vlan.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the vlan.
- `site_id` (Number) The ID of the site associated with the vlan.
- `status` (String) Valid values are `active`, `reserved` and `deprecated`. Defaults to `active`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the vlan.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the vlan was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `l2vpn_termination_id` (Number) The ID of the l2vpn termination associated with the vlan.
- `last_updated` (String) When the vlan was last changed.
- `prefix_count` (Number) The number of prefix objects that refer to the vlan.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_vlan.example 1
```
